t: A RISC-V Linux computer that fits BeagleBone add-on boards.
steps: Buy the board from a distributor such as DigiKey or Mouser for about 151 dollars.
Get a 5 V barrel jack power supply and a micro-USB 3.0 cable.
Read the official BeagleV-Ahead quick start guide on the BeagleBoard docs site.
Download the latest Debian or Ubuntu image from BeagleBoard.
Flash the image and power up the board with a monitor and keyboard attached.
Connect to Wi-Fi or plug in an Ethernet cable.
Open Visual Studio Code on your computer and write a Python script that blinks a user LED.
Try the official CSI camera demo next.
meta: Open Board. From $151. A few stores.
